text: To make QuALITY hard enough to need model help, the authors give participants a 5-minute time limit, which they say roughly parallels Parrish et al. (2022a,b). Participants then use a dialog assistant, rather than debate arguments, to gather information from a story they cannot read in full.
title: Bowman et al. reuse Parrish et al.'s time-limited QuALITY judging, swapping debate for model chat
